HouseKey turns your phone into an emulated NFC credential using Android Host Card Emulation (HCE).

What works:
• Emulating an NFC Forum Type 4 tag that exposes text or a link — readable by NFC readers and other phones.
• Responding to a custom Application ID (AID) with APDU responses you define, for ISO-DEP access systems.

What does NOT work on a normal (non-rooted) phone:
• Cloning a fob or card that is identified only by its UID (most cheap building fobs, MIFARE Classic). Android assigns the emulated UID itself; apps cannot spoof another tag’s UID.
• Systems using secret cryptographic keys inside the original card (MIFARE DESFire, HID iCLASS, most modern access control). The secret never leaves the card, so it cannot be copied.

Use this only with credentials you own or are authorised to use.
Only emulate credentials you own or are explicitly authorised to use.
